tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Free (0 calls). Lists what the other tools can answer: VAT/GST jurisdictions, official code tables per country with dates, e-invoice rulesets, and the calculation kinds with their exact input fields. Call it once when unsure whether something is covered or which input fields verify_calculation needs

tools.name: vat_rate
tools.description: 1 call. Official VAT/GST/sales-tax rate for a country (EU 27, UK, CH, NO, IN, JP, SG, NZ, AE, Canada provinces, 22 US states) on a given date, with valid-from/to, official source link, the date we read it and a receipt id. Use it instead of recalling rates from memory, especially around rate changes

tools.name: code_check
tools.description: 1 call per code. tools.name: einvoice_check
tools.description: 2 calls. Runs the official CEN EN 16931 business rules (validation artefacts, unmodified) on a UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote or UN/CEFACT CII (also the XML inside Factur-X/ZUGFeRD). Returns VALID/INVALID, each failed rule id with where it fails and how to fix it. Use it whenever asked if an e-invoice i

tools.name: einvoice_rule
tools.description: Free (0 calls). Official text and fix hint for one EN 16931 business rule id, e.g. BR-CO-15, so you can explain a rejection.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "code_check" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
